guidelines.detail: same as LRN-007 (The description distinguishes alternative destinations, and the reference flows show separate branches and activities for those alternatives. This is already stated essentially the same way by learned guideline LRN-007.)

documentation rule FID-03 not applied (The label pairs show generic or semantically different labels, while the description provides the relevant actions and process outcome. FID-03 already advises short, faithful labels and meaningful event triggers or outcomes.)

The reference places the decision gateway before the monitoring activity (F10, G1, G2), contrary to the description’s stated order. It also puts the inventory update directly on a parallel branch (F9), although the description says that update occurs after restocking is complete. These reference differences do not support a reliable guideline.

same as LRN-004 (The description names inspection, recording, and placement as required work after receipt and says the process ends after the restock is finished. The missing gateway and flow records show that the generated model did not represent the parallel split and synchronization expected by the reference. This is essentially the same rule as LRN-004.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that an item may be put away in one of multiple alternative locations: Model each alternative destination as a separate activity on a mutually exclusive branch, distinct from other stated handling activities.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description presents mutually exclusive alternatives for carrying out an action, such as alternatives joined by “or”

rules_sent_back.instruction: Use short, faithful labels in the input language. Prefer verb-object activity names and meaningful business triggers or outcomes for events.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description names an activity or event and states its action or outcome

rules_sent_back.instruction: When When a description names multiple distinct activities within one phase and states that the process continues only after every activity is finished,: model the activities as parallel branches with a parallel split and join, rather than as a sequence.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description names multiple distinct activities that must all occur within one phase and indicates that a later step waits until they are finished
